## Checklist

- [ ] I have read through [review guidelines](https://github.com/matronhq/matron-web/blob/develop/docs/review.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/matronhq/matron-web/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests written for new code (and old code if feasible).
- [ ] New or updated `public`/`exported` symbols have accurate [TSDoc](https://tsdoc.org/) documentation.
- [ ] Linter and other CI checks pass.
- [ ] I have agreed to license my contributions under the project's open source license.
